entries.title: TLAB presents: The Brave Fuzzy Author Talk
entries.description: Members of Pen Pipette, a nonprofit publisher for children's books run entirely by high school students, will dive into the inspirations behind the book, explore how art and science collide, and dive into a fun, hands-on workshop where you can experiment with your own creative ideas.
entries.priorTitleZh: TLAB：《勇敢的毛茸茸》作者分享
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 由高中生运营的儿童图书非营利出版社 Pen & Pipette 分享创作灵感，探讨艺术与科学如何结合，并带领大家动手实践创意。
